It also correctly places peak ozone loss in September and October and explains the recovery as the vortex breaks down. It stays well under 120 words. Its main omissions are that it never names human-made CFCs as the source of the chlorine, and it doesn't explicitly state that winter darkness is why chemistry waits for spring. Those gaps keep it from a top score, but the core reasoning is complete and clear.
